ticket.summary: New customer at 16 Weaver Court: hot side of original 1990s bathroom faucet drips constantly for 2-3 weeks, spout only, no leaks under sink; booked cartridge replacement.
mitigation_advice: Optional overnight fix: close the hot-side fixture shutoff valve under the sink (small oval handle on supply line, clockwise until snug) to stop the drip [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Faucet/shower cartridge replacement - hot side of bathroom lavatory faucet

ticket.customer_message: You're all set - Tuesday, Sep 1 at 10:30 AM at 16 Weaver Court, about 70 minutes on site, $159 for the cartridge replacement (tech will quote a full faucet swap first if parts aren't available). If the dripping keeps you up tonight, you can close the hot-side shutoff valve under the sink - the small oval handle on the supply line, clockwise until snug [PB-01]. Thanks, and sleep well!
